notes.title: The Archive Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34946933/eceb27b70c1737a1bab59ff65f531d1c20677bc0.gif

The Archive Update now packages DUSTNET onto a single dedicated server box that will preserve de_dust2 forever. With only 16-slots, every change players make to the DUSTNET server will be saved for future visitors. Pruning of the server will be important as the user generated structures grow, for more information please visit our Discord.

Changelist
A single 16-slot dedicated DUSTNET server now saves all map changes PERMANENTLY 
Autosave is triggered every 10 minutes and the last player on the server has access to a manual /save command
UI updates for every platform
Individual player editing limit removed
AR players can no longer attack other players
